gap: step-packet.gate.mjs used LF-only regex (```yaml\n) to detect YAML step blocks, but plan files on Windows use CRLF (\r\n), causing stepsChecked to return [] and the step-packet Tier-1 gate to silently fail on Windows hosts.
resolution: Regex updated to /```yaml\r?\n/ so the gate correctly matches CRLF and LF line endings. Gate now reports stepsChecked: [1] on Windows. This is a cross-platform line-ending gap that any future gate script reading plan files must account for.
resumeAction: Apply the CRLF-tolerant regex pattern to any future gate scripts that read YAML or markdown plan files. Validate gates on Windows before marking implementation [DONE].

gap: The fresh-process workflow MCP per-call plan_path override path lacked a focused red contract, so a missing requireString import escaped until Step 05, and workflow plan parsing depended on the exact ## Validation gates sentinel heading, so a temporary renamed heading blocked [WIP] phase detection.
resolution: The workstream repaired the missing requireString import in neataptic-workflow-mcp.mjs, restored the exact ## Validation gates heading in the tracker, and closed with explicit evidence that future MCP override coverage should include a fresh-process per-call plan_path probe and workflow trackers must preserve the parser sentinel unless the parser is hardened.
resumeAction: Archive the Layer 4 tracker and treat a VS Code reload or MCP restart as the only remaining live-runtime pickup step.

triggeringTask: Semantic Knowledge Embeddings orchestration - MCP tier-enforcement gate lookup failed
gap: MCP server constructs gate paths as `gates/${gateId}.gate.mjs`, but the tier-enforcement gate was shipped as `tier-enforcement-gate.mjs`. run_gate_check({ gate: "tier-enforcement" }) resolved to a missing file and failed. The naming mismatch means any gate whose filename uses the `-gate` suffix instead of the `.gate.mjs` MCP convention will silently fail when invoked via MCP.
resolution: Added thin forwarder `scripts/agent-customization/gates/tier-enforcement.gate.mjs` that re-exports and delegates to `tier-enforcement-gate.mjs`. Future gates must be named `<id>.gate.mjs` from the start to be MCP-visible without a forwarder.
resumeAction: MCP tier-enforcement gate now passes. Name future gates `<id>.gate.mjs`; avoid the `-gate` suffix for any gate that must be MCP-callable.

triggeringTask: Semantic Knowledge Embeddings orchestration - MCP active workflow snapshot failed on plan
gap: The MCP active workflow snapshot parser requires the H2 heading `## Validation gates` as an anchor. The plan used `## Acceptance criteria and validation gates`, causing the snapshot to fail to locate the validation section. Other active plans with non-standard H2 names risk the same silent failure.
resolution: 01-planning repaired the active plan heading to `## Validation gates` and rebuilt full step packet structure for Steps 03-07. Canonical plan anchors are `## Validation gates` and `## Step packets`; all new and repaired plans must use these exact strings.
resumeAction: Audit other active plans for non-standard H2 anchors when MCP snapshot fails. Use `## Validation gates` and `## Step packets` exactly.

triggeringTask: Semantic Knowledge Embeddings step packet promotion - 01-planning found missing required fields
gap: Future step packets in the active plan were missing `next_step`, `Required validation`, and `Stop conditions` YAML fields. The step-packet gate validates block existence but not field completeness, so malformed packets pass the gate and are only caught when promotion is attempted.
resolution: 01-planning repaired the missing fields in Steps 03-07 inline. No gate extension was made in this pass. A future maintenance pass should extend step-packet.gate.mjs or a companion schema check to assert these three fields exist in every step YAML block.
resumeAction: Always include `next_step`, `Required validation`, and `Stop conditions` when authoring step packets. Consider a future gate field-presence check in step-packet.gate.mjs.

triggeringTask: Semantic Knowledge Embeddings 04-implementing / 05-green-testing - npm ci blocked on Windows
gap: On Windows, the live `neataptic-workflow-mcp` (repo-cortex-mcp) process holds `better_sqlite3.node` open via an active SQLite connection. `npm ci` cannot overwrite the locked native binary and fails with a permission error. This blocks all install-requiring CI-equivalent steps while the MCP server is active.
resolution: Environmental constraint documented as log-only evidence. No code or agent changes in this pass. Agents should warn users to stop the MCP server (or close VS Code) before running `npm ci` on Windows when better-sqlite3 is a dependency.
resumeAction: When npm ci fails on Windows with a permission error on better_sqlite3.node, close VS Code or kill the MCP server process, re-run npm ci, then reopen VS Code. This is a permanent Windows-only constraint for this repo while better-sqlite3 is a native dependency.

triggeringTask: Semantic Knowledge Dense Prewarm workflow MCP binding repair

resolution: Hardened mcp-plan-utils.mjs to use an H2 boundary containing validation gates, added a focused node:test regression against plans/Semantic_Knowledge_Dense_Prewarm.plans.md, and validated workflow MCP self-check plus plan-sync against the active plan.
resumeAction: Retry the live workflow MCP snapshot for plans/Semantic_Knowledge_Dense_Prewarm.plans.md, then rerun Phase 1 Step 01 or advance to Phase 2 Step 02 according to the main coordinator's workflow state.

triggeringTask: Recurring session-start MCP workflow error diagnosis and fix
gap: get_active_workflow_snapshot hard-threw Expected exactly one [WIP] phase ... found 0 when called on a plan with 0 WIP phases (e.g. freshly created workstream or plan redirected before Phase 1 was marked [WIP]). This caused isError: true at session start, wasting time as agents struggled to recover from a non-blocking condition.
resolution: Changed the get_active_workflow_snapshot handler in neataptic-workflow-mcp.mjs to catch the no-WIP-phase and no-WIP-step errors and return a structured scope: no-active-phase response with fallbackAdvice instead of propagating isError. The validation MCP remains strict. Added a session-start handling section to .github/copilot-instructions.md documenting the no-active-phase scope contract and the correct fallback (direct plan file read; auto-advance Phase 1 Step 01). Updated 01.phase-kickoff.flow.yml and 01.step-packet-revision.flow.yml to note that scope no-active-phase is a normal startup condition.
resumeAction: MCP workflow server now restarts cleanly from all session states. Continue active workstream without manual workaround.
